recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not add redundant wording unless a future concrete inconsistency appears; related POST-search mechanics are already covered by existing FHIR-31943/FHIR-31944 reconciliation commits and current source.
issue_request: FHIR-33220 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R5. It asked how Bundle.link[relation='self'] should represent a POST /_search request with form-encoded body parameters and resolved that the self link must always be expressed as [base](/[resource])?[params], never [base](/[resource])/_search?[params], even if that GET-style URL is not supported or resolvable.
initial_application: No Jira-keyed source commit for FHIR-33220 was found, but the search page was rewritten shortly after the January 2022 vote. Commit 36e9fd596f19 added the self-link section with a GET-based query-parameter rule and non-resolvable-link note; commit 2a58db6fee40 refined it to an HTTP GET-based self link valid for equivalent searches regardless of GET, POST, messaging, etc.; later edits such as a3766ac36c6 only adjusted conformance markup around the same rule.
additional_context: FHIR-31943 and FHIR-31944 are the related POST-search issues cited by the FHIR-33220 resolution and are already represented on the combined branch. Current source/search.html also requires paging links to be GET requests, while source/http.html describes GET/POST search support and POST parameter handling. Zulip and FHIR-I minutes corroborate that FHIR-33220 was intended to make the GET-shaped self-link behavior explicit and was partially duplicative of the related POST-search issues.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because source/search.html already says self links SHALL be HTTP GET-based with the relevant parameters included as query parameters, may be non-resolvable, and are valid for equivalent searches regardless of how the search was performed.
